# TPC-Havoc Q5_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH asia_nations AS (
  SELECT
    n_nationkey,
    n_name
  FROM nation, region
  WHERE
    n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name = 'ASIA'
), qualified_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o_orderkey,
    o_custkey
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    o_orderdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND o_orderdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
), qualified_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c_custkey,
    c_nationkey
  FROM customer
), qualified_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    s_suppkey,
    s_nationkey
  FROM supplier
), revenue_base AS (
  SELECT
    an.n_name,
    l.l_extendedprice * (
      1 - l.l_discount
    ) AS item_revenue
  FROM asia_nations AS an
  JOIN qualified_suppliers AS qs
    ON an.n_nationkey = qs.s_nationkey
  JOIN qualified_customers AS qc
    ON qs.s_nationkey = qc.c_nationkey
  JOIN qualified_orders AS qo
    ON qc.c_custkey = qo.o_custkey
  JOIN lineitem AS l
    ON qo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey AND qs.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
)
SELECT
  n_name,
  SUM(item_revenue) AS revenue
FROM revenue_base
GROUP BY
  n_name
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
```
